com.vector.cfg.model.asr.ecuc.groovy

Interface IEcucUnresolvedReferenceSelector


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IEcucUnresolvedReferenceSelector
    The IEcucUnresolvedReferenceSelector selects a set of unresolved references by providing several filter methods.
    Predicates can be set by several methods. These can be used to filter the unresolved references.
